versions.description:
Versions are ordered by EffectiveFrom descending. Empty when no version
has been published, which is a 200 rather than a 404: unlike a point read
of a named version, a listing of nothing is an answer.

created_at.description:
CreatedAt is when the row was written, which differs from EffectiveFrom
for a staged version and for the shipped baseline (dated in a 1970 epoch
band so it never outranks an operator's own rates).

effective_from.description:
EffectiveFrom is when this version takes, or took, effect — and the key
that addresses it on GET /v1/budgets/pricing/versions/{effectiveFrom}. A
value in the future is a staged version, which every pricing write
refuses until it becomes active or is deleted.

snapshotDate.description:
SnapshotDate names the shipped-baseline snapshot THIS version's
baseline-managed entries track — not the one the running binary ships.
Empty for any version published before the pointer survived a per-entry
write, which is every version currently in the field.
